thread.title: Wall Street Surrenders Early Gains as Hopes For Trade Deal Extinguished

author: MT Newswires
title: Wall Street Surrenders Early Gains as Hopes For Trade Deal Extinguished
text:
Shutterstock photo Stocks surrendered premarket gains and were trading with heavy losses after hopes for a US/China trade deal were dashed, wiping out a more than 300-point gain in Dow futures. Weighed by outsized losses in components Apple ( AAPL ) and Kraft Heinz ( KHC ), the Nasdaq Composite is underperforming its peers and is in the red for the first time in four days.
Despite Friday's poor price action, all the major indices -- including the Russell 2000 -- are still indicated to close the week higher. This would be the first higher weekly close for the small-cap index in seven weeks and the first for the Nasdaq in five weeks.
